Hi Alice / Jordan,

Thanks for the questionnaire — I started filling it out and put together the initial evidence bundle. Answers / highlights below (I’ve attached a short artifact list and a redacted SOC 2 draft):

Q: Encryption at rest / KMS
A: All customer data is encrypted at rest. We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (CMK) for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys by default, but we can enable CMK on request for enterprise plans.

Q: Breach notification SLA
A: Our policy is to notify affected customers and FinTechCorp point-of-contact within 72 hours after we confirm a security incident that impacts customer data, unless notification is legally prohibited. For incidents with potential customer data exfiltration, we escalate internally within 4 hours and initiate customer notification within 72 hours.

Q: Incident response process / evidence
A: We maintain a documented IR playbook, queueing and triage procedures (PagerDuty + internal runbooks), and post-incident reports. Recovery timelines depend on severity; typical customer-impacting incidents are treated as Sev1 with 24–72 hour recovery targets and ongoing updates every 4 hours during active remediation.

Q: BCP / DR evidence
A: RTO for control-plane services: 1–4 hours depending on service; RPO: < 15 mins for critical stores. We perform annual DR tests and quarterly tabletop exercises. Most recent full DR test: 2026-11-12.

Attachments included (redacted where appropriate):
- SOC2_TypeII_Draft.pdf (redacted draft; final Type II expected Q4 2027)
- BCP_DR_Evidence_List.xlsx (list of artifacts & redaction guidance)

Notes on evidence delivery: For full reports we share via a secure S3 presigned link or our compliance portal (preferred). Let me know which you prefer and I’ll generate access.

If helpful, I can also provide a short slide deck summarizing controls mapped to your questionnaire sections (CCPA/GDPR/HIPAA mappings).

On the questionnaire, I’ve filled the following sections and left procurement-specific fields (billing legal entity, PO terms) for Jordan/Ben to handle: 
- Security controls: answered
- IR / notification: answered
- Compliance posture & audit schedule: answered

Would recommend returning the filled PDF by Jul 8 to give procurement a couple business days to ingest before your Jul 12 committee date.

Thanks,
